title: What Is The 'Black Cat Clapping' Meme? The Origin Of The Viral AI Cat Memes Explained
key_facts: An AI-generated cat with a human smile and hands has gone viral on Instagram and TikTok as the 'Black Cat Clapping' or 'Clapping Cat' meme.
It has been spreading since the end of September 2026.
It comes from Instagram user merkurianin, in a clip generated or edited with an AI video tool, in which the cat stands up, applauds and points at him after being fed.
The clip had over 2.6 million views within a few weeks.
A few days later TikToker @asian5767 used a green-screen version captioned 'Bro we're skipping stop clapping'.
Other versions include a claymation cat by @fajnyczlowiek01 (early October 2026) and a mash-up with a scene from the film The Cat Returns by @aguxx_edit13.
quote_evidence: The Black Cat Clapping meme originally comes to us from Instagram user merkurianin, which was generated or edited using an AI video tool.
This video strikes a balance between being creepy and funny and garnered over 2.6 million views in just a few weeks.
why_it_matters_hint: Shows one AI-made clip turning into a reusable meme format within weeks.
event_date: End of Sep 2026 (first post); guide published 13 Oct 2026
notes: Full text read. Origin and view count come from the guide itself; the AI tool used is not named and the 'AI-made' point is hedged by the article ('generated or edited'). Ongoing trend, so freshness NEW with the start date in the summary.
